name: Composite Fabrics of America LLC
old_description: Carbon fiber and composite materials for aerospace applications
about:
Composite Fabrics of America LLC operates from Hiddenite, North Carolina, as a wholly owned subsidiary of Schneider Mills, one of the oldest and most advanced weaving mills in the United States. The company leverages that heritage to produce carbon fiber and composite reinforcements for demanding applications.

The firm specializes in producing industry-standard and custom reinforcing materials for aerospace composite part fabrication and repair. Its textile engineering team develops custom reinforcing products to meet design-specific requirements, reduce waste, or add aesthetic appeal, and offers a "Bill and Hold" service to buffer customers against price and availability fluctuations.

Primary markets include aerospace, automotive, infrastructure, and athletics. Customers range from aerospace fabricators and repair stations to automotive and industrial designers seeking collaborative development of innovative components.

The company cites its AS9100 Rev D certification, the legacy of Schneider Mills' weaving expertise, and its in-house textile engineering capability as key differentiators that enable high-quality, tailored composite fabrics.
